topology: Chiplet A: AXI Streaming → Streaming Interface/FDI → UCIe D2D Controller → RDI → UCIe PHY
Chiplet B: UCIe PHY → RDI → UCIe D2D Controller → Streaming Interface/FDI → AXI Streaming

assumptions: AoU credit depth = 32 (not on slide; sized to exercise retry/TX without artificial starvation).
Serialization/propagation/buffer cycles are simulation configuration, not vendor timing.
Retrain = 5 us, LinkReset = 10 us, reactivation = 2 us are simulation configuration.
L1 entry/exit/hold dwells are simulation configuration.
Early credit return frees a credit when RX accepts a flit; updates batch at threshold=2.
Retrain preserves retry buffer contents (policy); LinkReset/LinkError flush (spec).
Error log fields are implementation diagnostics, not standardized UCIe register layouts.
Streaming/Format-6/x16/FDI-512 are recorded as reference metadata; PHY bit timing is not modeled.
Single-inflight slot is an optional experiment mode; reference configs disable it.

timing_traceability.parameter: Outstanding AXI fate after LinkError = Discard

findings.name: UNKNOWN after architectural commit
findings.why: Post-commit response loss under LinkError still leaves observers A–C at UNKNOWN; ground truth commit=1.
findings.cause: general UCIe/AoU recovery semantics + Discard policy

findings.name: Duplicate commit after blind retry
findings.why: Auto-retry policy still reissues a committed write when the initiator sees no completion.

findings.name: Pre-target UNKNOWN (observer A)
findings.why: AXI-only observer still cannot distinguish pre-target loss from post-commit loss.

findings.name: ACK history reduces UNKNOWN (observer D)
findings.why: Latched NAK-only disposition still maps pre-target loss to NOT_COMPLETED for observer D.

findings.name: OBSERVATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE (A/B/C)
findings.why: Committed+lost-response vs never-arrived still look identical to observers A–C.

findings.name: Retry buffer peak
findings.why: Under reference multi-outstanding transport, retry occupancy peaked at 3 (capacity 16). The previous peak=1 was an artifact of single_inflight_slot mode.
findings.cause: removal of single_inflight_slot + retry buffer depth 16

findings.name: Cross-client / cross-guest delay
findings.why: Client B quiet=46.0 ns, faulted=90.0 ns, delta=44.0 ns. Interference magnitude similar to the old single-slot result despite multi-outstanding flits.

findings.name: Deadline miss under Client-A replay
findings.why: Client B misses Option B deadline 55.20 ns (= quiet×1.20) under Client A CRC/replay storm (latency 90.0 ns).

findings.name: transport delivery knowledge != architectural commit
findings.why: Reference config still has no end-to-end commit bit; flit ACK does not imply AXI completion.

findings.name: Diagnostics turn UNKNOWN into determined fate (A)
findings.why: Error log recorded 8 entries but observer A fate remained UNKNOWN. Implementation diagnostics do not synthesize an AXI completion or commit bit.
findings.cause: diagnostics are not bound to AXI transaction fate

findings.name: CREDIT_CONSERVATION under early return + recovery
findings.why: Early credit return with threshold=2 did not break conservation absent injected credit faults.

questions.q1_surviving: UNKNOWN after architectural commit; Duplicate commit after blind retry; Pre-target UNKNOWN (observer A); ACK history reduces UNKNOWN (observer D); OBSERVATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE (A/B/C); Cross-client / cross-guest delay; Deadline miss under Client-A replay; transport delivery knowledge != architectural commit; CREDIT_CONSERVATION under early return + recovery
questions.q3_internal_states: Retry-buffer occupancy and ACK/NAK disposition before flush; FDI destructive vs Retrain; architectural commit vs response delivery
questions.q4_error_logging: No for observer A (still UNKNOWN). Diagnostics record CRC/retry/recovery and buffer snapshots but do not bind to AXI completion or commit.
questions.q5_next_poc: Validate against real UCIe IP: (1) post-commit response loss → UNKNOWN, (2) multi-flit retry occupancy under CRC bursts, (3) early-credit + retry interaction, (4) LinkError flush vs Retrain preserve policy, (5) whether vendor diagnostics expose enough state to reduce UNKNOWN without inventing a commit bit.
